name: Impobarato
description: Appliance retailer in Uruguay with an online store on the Fenicio platform and a branch in Montevideo. Sells kitchen, refrigeration, laundry, TV and audio, climate and small home appliances. States free shipping across the country for customers with an account; no minimum purchase is stated.
description_es: Comercio de electrodomésticos en Uruguay con tienda online sobre la plataforma Fenicio y una sucursal en Montevideo. Vende cocina, refrigeración, lavado, TV y audio, climatización y pequeños electrodomésticos. Indica envío gratis a todo el país para clientes con cuenta, sin mínimo de compra indicado.

ships_to.notes: Free shipping to the whole country for customers with an account. Standard cost and times for other cases not stated.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Lists a Montevideo branch (Ellauri 623); collection at the branch is not explicitly described on the homepage.
